OCR Scanner – PDF & Text

Privacy Policy

How documents stay on your device, and how purchases, ads, privacy choices and this website work.

Effective 7 October 2026On-device Android edition
Policy scopeDocuments stay on your deviceCollection and sharingPro purchasesAds and privacy choicesApp configurationStorage and retentionExports and supportWebsite and hostingYour choices and requestsChanges to this policyFrench and Arabic summaries

Policy scope

This policy describes OCR Scanner – PDF & Text, the on-device Android application with package com.chandra.ocr.offline, and this product website. Version 1.2.0 introduced advertising and online app configuration using test ads. Version 1.2.1 supports configurable advertising modes. Its current mode is OFF, with test and commercial ads disabled through app configuration. Commercial advertising may be enabled after an authorized store launch and the required privacy setup. Version 1.1.0 includes optional Samsung purchases but no ads. Earlier version 1.0.1 has no in-app purchases or ads. This policy does not describe separate cloud or development editions.

The independent publisher of OCR Scanner can be reached at chennoufo11@gmail.com for privacy and support questions.

Documents stay on your device

You select image or PDF files, or capture a page with a camera application. The app copies normalized page images into its private device storage and saves document titles, dates, page adjustments, favorites and recognized text locally.

English and French recognition use bundled Google ML Kit models. Arabic recognition uses bundled Tesseract and its Arabic model. These models are included with the installation. Recognition does not require a user account, model download or internet connection.

Collection and sharing

The on-device app does not upload your documents or recognized text to the publisher, Google, Datalab or another OCR service. Document titles, images, text and OCR language choices are not sent as ad targeting information. There is no publisher-operated user account or separate analytics service. We do not receive document content from this app.

The app uses internet access for Samsung purchases, Google advertising and privacy messages, and downloading its public configuration. Recognition continues to work offline. These services process the connection and service information described below.

Android, camera apps, file providers and applications you choose to use have their own privacy practices. Permissions and access you grant to these services are controlled by your device and those services.

Optional Pro purchase

OCR Scanner Pro is an optional one-time purchase processed through Galaxy Store using Samsung IAP. Product prices, payment, ownership checks and restore requests are handled by Samsung. A Samsung account and internet connection are needed for purchase or restore. We do not receive or store your payment card details.

The SDK receives product details and purchase/ownership identifiers and uses them to unlock Pro and acknowledge delivery to Samsung. It may process account, device, network and transaction information under Samsung’s privacy policy. Document images and recognized text are not included in these purchase requests.

The app stores a device-bound, authenticated Pro entitlement locally, so previously confirmed Pro access can continue offline. Successful ownership checks update this entitlement, including removing it when the store reports no purchase. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes the local cache; use Restore purchases with the same Samsung account to recover eligible purchases.

Ads and privacy choices

From version 1.2.0, Free can display Google AdMob ads. Version 1.2.1 supports test or commercial advertising, with OFF currently selected: test and commercial ads are disabled. When enabled, test ads still contact Google; they are not an offline simulation. The data handling below applies when either advertising mode is enabled. Confirmed Pro access suppresses ads and ad loading.

Google’s advertising SDK collects and shares IP addresses (which can indicate approximate location), ad/app interactions, diagnostics, and device or account identifiers such as the advertising ID and app set ID. Google uses this information for advertising, measurement and fraud prevention. Requests are encrypted in transit. See Google’s SDK data disclosure and Google’s Privacy Policy.

Google’s privacy message manages applicable choices before ad requests are allowed. Where required, Ad privacy choices in Settings lets you review or change your choices. Choices are stored by the consent service on your device. Basic document recognition remains available if ads cannot be requested. Changing a choice affects future requests; it does not erase information already received by Google.

You can also reset or delete your advertising ID through your device’s advertising settings. Google’s own privacy controls and policy govern access, deletion and retention of information it holds.

App configuration

The app downloads a small public configuration file over HTTPS from raw.githubusercontent.com to control whether ads are enabled, their test or commercial mode, placements and frequency. This request includes normal connection information such as your IP address and HTTP request metadata. It does not include documents, recognized text or purchase receipts. GitHub processes hosting information under its Privacy Statement.

The app keeps a local configuration cache and timing preferences in private device storage. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes these local values. A remote configuration does not upload documents or change your Pro ownership or privacy choices.

Storage and retention

Documents, page images and results remain in private device storage until you delete them, clear the app’s data or uninstall it. Android backup of app data is disabled. Android app sandboxing protects the stored files; this app does not add separate database encryption. Purchase entitlement, app configuration and privacy preferences are also held locally. Google, Samsung and GitHub determine retention of information received by their services under their own policies; clearing app storage does not delete those providers’ records.

The Delete document action stops local processing and removes the saved pages, local OCR job files and the document database entry. Deleting an individual draft page removes that saved page. Temporary capture or processing files may remain after an interrupted operation until document deletion or app storage is cleared.

Exports and support

Sharing and exports happen only when you initiate them through Android’s chooser or file picker. The destination you select receives that content. Exported and shared copies are outside the app and are not deleted when you remove the original document.

If you email chennoufo11@gmail.com, we receive the information and attachments you choose to send and use them to respond to your request. Avoid sending confidential documents. We do not need your scan content to answer ordinary app questions. Your email service and our email provider also process those messages under their own policies. Support correspondence is retained only for responding and any applicable recordkeeping requirements; ask us to delete it when no longer needed.

Website and hosting

This website does not ask you to upload documents, create an app account or provide payment information. We have not added advertising trackers, analytics scripts, contact forms or third-party media embeds. Fonts, screenshots and other page assets are served with the website.

The website’s hosting and security providers, including GitHub Pages and its infrastructure, may process normal connection information such as your IP address, request metadata and browser details for delivery, abuse prevention and security. Provider-managed cookies or access controls may be used by that infrastructure. Their policies govern their own processing. Reading the bundled privacy policy inside the app does not contact this website.

Your choices and requests

You can view, share and delete local documents in the app. You can also clear app storage through Android Settings or uninstall the app. We do not hold a server copy of your offline documents and cannot recover documents deleted from your device.

For Google advertising data, Samsung purchase data or GitHub hosting data, use the relevant provider’s privacy controls or contact that provider. The publisher cannot delete records held only by those providers. For questions or requests about information you sent us directly, contact chennoufo11@gmail.com. Depending on where you live, applicable privacy law may provide rights to access, correct or delete that information. We will respond in accordance with applicable requirements.

This app does not request children’s personal information. If a child sends personal information to support, a parent or guardian may contact us to request its removal.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the app or website changes. The effective date will be updated. Material changes to the app’s data handling will be described in the relevant release notes and policy. We will update the current-mode notice when advertising mode changes. A later cloud edition or a change to the information collected will need updated disclosures before its release.

Résumé en français

Les documents et textes reconnus restent sur votre appareil. Les modèles sont intégrés ; la reconnaissance fonctionne sans compte ni Internet. Dès la version 1.1.0, l’achat facultatif de Pro passe par Samsung IAP ; l’application ne conserve pas vos données de carte. La version 1.2.1 permet des publicités AdMob de test ou commerciales, mais le mode actuel est OFF : les publicités de test et commerciales sont désactivées. Lorsqu’ils sont activés, ces services contactent Google et peuvent transmettre des identifiants, l’adresse IP, des interactions et des diagnostics. Les documents ne servent pas au ciblage publicitaire. Pro désactive les publicités. Les options de confidentialité sont accessibles dans les paramètres lorsque nécessaire. La configuration publique vient de GitHub ; cette connexion ne transmet aucun document. Effacer les données locales ne supprime pas les données détenues par ces fournisseurs. Pour l’assistance : chennoufo11@gmail.com.

ملخص بالعربية

تبقى المستندات والنصوص المستخرجة على جهازك. نماذج التعرف مضمّنة وتعمل المعالجة دون حساب أو إنترنت. ابتداءً من الإصدار 1.1.0، يتم شراء Pro الاختياري عبر Samsung IAP؛ لا يحتفظ التطبيق ببيانات البطاقة. يدعم الإصدار 1.2.1 إعلانات AdMob تجريبية أو تجارية، لكن الوضع الحالي هو OFF والإعلانات التجريبية والتجارية معطّلة. عند تفعيلها، تتصل هذه الخدمات بـGoogle وقد ترسل معرّفات الجهاز وعنوان IP ومعلومات التفاعل والتشخيص. لا تُستخدم مستنداتك لاستهداف الإعلانات. يوقف Pro الإعلانات، وتتوفر خيارات الخصوصية في الإعدادات عند الحاجة. تأتي إعدادات التطبيق العامة من GitHub دون إرسال المستندات. مسح بيانات التطبيق المحلية لا يحذف البيانات التي تحتفظ بها هذه الجهات. للتواصل: chennoufo11@gmail.com.
